title: NEST Simulator
summary: The NEST Initiative maintains an open-source simulator for spiking neural networks (SNNs) focused on computational neuroscience. It supports over 50 neuron and synapse models with a Python interface designed for high-precision simulations of large-scale networks containing millions to billions of connections. The framework emphasizes network dynamics, structure, and electrophysiological logic rather than individual neuronal morphology. NEST utilizes efficient parallel computing strategies that optimize memory usage and energy consumption while integrating with various neuroinformatics tools.
tldr: NEST is a high-performance, open-source simulator for large-scale spiking neural networks developed by the NEST Initiative to support computational neuroscience research.
evidence: Overview NEST is a prominent open-source simulator for spiking neural network (SNN) models, mainly used in computational neuroscience.
The project is developed and maintained by the NEST Initiative...

It excels in high-precision simulations of large networks, capable of handling millions and billions of synaptic connections.
